title: Learning A Sparse Transformer Network for Effective Image Deraining
grouping: Two bands split by a full-width horizontal dashed rule. The top band is the whole encoder-decoder unfolded onto one row (input thumbnail, 3x3, MEFC, three STB, the bottleneck STB, three STB with concat circles, MEFC, 3x3, add, output thumbnail), with a dashed rounded legend box at its far right. The bottleneck STB is drawn expanded in place as an orange-tinted dashed rounded container holding its sub-blocks (LN, TKSA, add, LN, MSFN, add) with 'STB' written inside it. The bottom band is three side-by-side dashed rounded panels of equal height (MEFC, TKSA, MSFN), each titled with full name plus acronym along its bottom edge. Block types share colour families across both bands: blue for 1x1 / 3x3 / Dw-Conv / ReLU, green for MEFC, orange for STB, grey for Reshape, white for LN; inside the MEFC panel the expert-weight squares and the expert boxes each sit in their own solid rounded container.
shapes_depth: Flat 2-D throughout: no shadows, gradients or 3-D blocks. Modules are tall narrow rounded rectangles with thin black outlines and labels rotated 90 degrees in bold serif type; panel boxes are small rounded rectangles of the same style. Operators are small outlined circles carrying multiply, C (concat) and plus glyphs. Tensors are not drawn as volumes: feature sizes appear only as italic H x W x C style text under each stage. Skip connections are orthogonal polylines that rise above the row and nest by depth (longest outermost), landing on a concat circle or the final add; inside each detail panel the residual path is a thin line routed around the panel content to a plus circle at its right end. The rainy input and derained output are photo thumbnails at the two ends of the row.
proposed_highlight: The paper's modules are named by bold acronyms on the blocks (MEFC, STB, TKSA, MSFN) and each overview block type has its own fill (green MEFC, orange STB). The bottleneck STB is the one block expanded inline in the overview, and the three new components each get a dedicated dashed detail panel below, captioned with the full name and acronym in bold. Inside the TKSA panel the selection steps (Mask, Top-k, Scatter, Softmax) are the only boxes in distinct pastel fills against blue convolutions and grey reshapes, with Top-k the most saturated.
lesson: Unfolding the U-shaped network onto a single row, with skip connections as nested arcs over the top, frees a full-width strip underneath for one equal-height dashed detail panel per proposed module, while the bottleneck block is expanded in place inside a tinted container of its own colour.
notes: 'other' element = italic tensor-size annotations (e.g. H/2 x W/2 x 2C) under each stage. Underbraces with xN0..xN4 sit beneath each stage to show repetition counts. Arrow labels include Q, K, V, indices, P1/S1/P2/S2. The TKSA panel has a small grid of 0 entries drawn as a matrix feeding the Softmax box. id follows the first-word-of-title rule; the network itself is not named in the drawing.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two bands split by a full-width dashed rule: the top band unfolds the whole U-shaped encoder-decoder onto one row with the bottleneck STB expanded in place as an orange dashed container; the bottom band holds three equal dashed panels (MEFC, TKSA, MSFN) each titled along its bottom edge.
insights.data: Rainy input and derained output are real photos at the two ends; feature sizes appear only as italic H x W x C text under each stage, and the TKSA panel draws its top-k mask as a small green 0/... grid.
insights.emphasis: The proposed modules get the only saturated fills (green MEFC, orange STB, yellow Top-k) while plain convs are blue, and the bottleneck STB is opened up in situ rather than in a separate panel.
insights.flow: Left to right; skip connections rise above the row as nested orthogonal polylines from each encoder stage to its concat circle in the decoder, and a global residual runs over the top from input to the final add.
insights.avoid: The symbol legend (multiply, concat, addition) is boxed at the far right of the top band and competes with the output photo; module labels are rotated 90 degrees in bold serif, which is hard to read.

arrangement.units: a top band with the full network on one row, then a row of three dashed rounded panels for module details, each titled with full name and acronym at its bottom edge
arrangement.inputs_as: a real rainy photo at the left edge of the top band
arrangement.shared: block-type colours (blue conv, green MEFC, orange STB, grey Reshape) reused across both bands
